target.statement: IDOL achieves MSE 0.008, PSNR 21.673, LPIPS 1.138 on the HuGe100K test set (full model).

compute.basis: Training IDOL requires 32 H100 GPUs for ~1 day; even inference needs a GPU with large VRAM (Sapiens-1B encoder + 0.5B transformer).

blockers: No code or model weights released
title: IDOL: Instant Photorealistic 3D Human Creation from a Single Image
